name: Grick
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.description: The grick has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The grick makes one attack with its tentacles. If that attack hits, the grick can make one beak attack against the same target.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

tactics: The grick coils on walls and ceilings (Stone Camouflage, climb 30), dropping on prey and dragging it away with its tentacles. It lurks in the ruined tunnels near the Woodland Manse. Nonmagical weapons are resisted — a nasty surprise for under-equipped parties.
